sources.text: I celebrated my 30th birthday at E’s, and I truly could not have asked for a better experience!!!!!!!!! Ajay and Mia took amazing care of us and were so attentive to our group of 23, making sure we had everything we needed to enjoy the night. The food and drinks were incredible !!! Our open bar package was immaculate and so smooth! We also ordered large platters, and everything was handled with so much care and attention. My friend and I went last night and this place was SO FUNNNNNNNNNNN! The drinks were amazing and Ruben took great care of us! Definitely will be coming back when we’re in New York again:) happy hour ends at 4p on saturdays fyi. but i fw this place, def was the 1/3 black people in here BUT the fries and smash burger are delish anddddd Franklin is the best. give him a raise 👏🏽 and there are card games! not reg cards tho if you’re trying to play spades or spoons Came to e’s Bar on a crowded weekend night with a big group of friends and had a blast! Service was prompt and friendly. Food was tasty. Tons of drink options at reasonable prices. Would recommend!

Both the service and the atmosphere were impressive, each receiving 4 stars for creating a great environment. Jan 1, 2026 Walked in on New Year’s Eve for some drinks and stayed for a few hours until the fire works. The staff were cool and the drinks (snowtini) were great! Fab atmosphere and the fact you could walk in on nye was epic. Much better set up than having a ticketed event, which as tourists was a bit off putting. I’d go back for sure Read more Jun 4, 2025 Their food is very delicious and mostly priced at around the same. A bit expensive and the quesadilla wasn't worth it but overall, definitely worth trying their chicken sandwich and margarita pizza. I love the darker atmosphere and it's date friendly. Jun 4, 2024 My favorite go to spot on the UWS! The staff are so warm and welcoming. The food is always delicious! The drinks are endless and crafted to perfection. It’s always a vibe at Lilly’s! I could never get bored of this place. I’ve come to Lilly’s for lunch, dinner, casual drinks, post work vibes and even ordered catering from them once for work. Highly recommend!!! Special love goes to Ashley and Joey ☺️ Read more 4 more reviews Nov 10, 2023 My friend and I came here for a quick drink before catching a show in the Beacon Theatre. Lilly’s Cocktail and Wine is a cozy bar that really decked out for the Halloween and fall vibes. We were able to be seated right away, and was able to pretty much order, finish our drinks, and leave within 40 minutes. I got the Uptown Girl, which was a floral and strong drink. I thought it would be a bit sweeter, but it ended up being tarter than I thought. My friend got the Dark Fables, which she really liked. Sadly, it had walnut bitters, which I’m allergic to, but it looked good! The atmosphere was… Read more Aug 12, 2023 Our waitress was super nice. There was a wide selection of food for vegetarians and non vegetarians. Nice outdoor seating or indoor. Slightly noisier inside. Fun selection of drinks and food. Food was good quality and yummy. Nice option on Saturday afternoon. We were pleased. Inside is a tad small so not ideal for groups. Read more Mar 20, 2023 Cute place with indoor and outdoor seating. We were informed in advance that food will take some time to arrive. We had LILLY'S PILSNER, Western omelet, Lillys breakfast burger and WAFFLE A LA MODE. Very happy with the burger and Waffle but Omelet and toast were burnt. Jun 22, 2021 Great spot !! The service and food is fantastic. Portions are generous and super delicious. We had the warm olives and mushroom brushetta(Highly reccomend) Then we had the roadted sweet potato salad with salmon and the fish tacos. The drinks are great, wise variety and unique. Reccomend the uptown girl with lavender. Will definitely go back. review3: Bar food such as fries and the smash burger gets praise, and guests mention extras like games that make the evening more social.
review4: At Lilly's Cocktail & Wine on West 72nd, guests describe a cozy, date-friendly bar with warm staff and good cocktails, though some find the food a little pricey.
